reason: I'd try the free dishes, but nothing here says how much oil, salt or calories are in them, and that's the whole reason I cook at home. Fried egg, omelet, coconut curry, braised pork are not what I'm trying to eat every week, so I wouldn't pre-pay for 12 more dishes I haven't seen yet.
objection: It doesn't speak to cooking healthy, and I don't know if the recipes work in a tiny kitchen with one pan.
would_change_my_mind: If the pack showed lighter versions with oil and salt amounts and calories per serving, all doable in one pan.
